name: enricher-query-allowlist
title: Query Allowlist Enricher
description: Enricher that drops http.search by default (or keeps only allowlisted query params) so query-string PII never reaches sinks.
docs: Wire the enricher: add `queryAllowlist()` to the init() enrichers array in telemetry/logger.ts (pass { allow: ["page"] } to keep specific params). Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add enricher query-allowlist` — it wires logger.ts for you.
